content.subject: Operational Deployment Brief — USCSS Meridian MRD-2183
content.body:
Officer Verlaine,

This brief supersedes all prior communication regarding cargo manifest MRD-2183.

Container XB-71 is to be treated as a PRIORITY SPECIMEN TRANSPORT. You are not to open, scan, or interfere with the container under any circumstances. The container's environmental controls are self-sustaining.

In the event of any anomalous readings from XB-71 or the surrounding cargo bay, you are to SEAL BAY C2 immediately and await further instruction via long-range comms.

Do NOT engage crew medical until you have contacted this office.

This communication is classified RESTRICTED. Do not distribute.

W-Y Operations
Project Prometheus Division
